name: Divyanubhuti
summary:
Welcome to Divyanubhuti, the premiere Virtual Reality application designed to guide you on a transformative spiritual journey. Divyanubhuti (meaning "Divine Experience") leverages the immersive power of VR to transport you to the most serene and sacred spaces, helping you discover inner peace and mindfulness like never before.

Key Features:

- Immersive Sacred Environments: Explore meticulously crafted 3D temples, tranquil nature retreats, and cosmic meditation spaces that feel incredibly real.
- Guided Me
